alerts.invalidWhatsapp: Enter a number with area code, e.g. (11) 98765-4321.
alerts.cityRequired: Enter the city where you work.
alerts.lgpdRequired: You must authorize the use of your data in accordance with the LGPD.
alerts.uploadBlockedCors: The browser blocked the direct upload to R2 (CORS). On the bucket, allow the app origins, GET/PUT/HEAD methods, and ExposeHeaders ETag.
alerts.uploadMissingEtag: R2 did not return an ETag. In the bucket CORS, include ExposeHeaders: ETag.
alerts.uploadR2Unauthorized: R2 rejected the credentials. In Cloudflare: R2 → Manage R2 API Tokens, create an S3 token (not an API token), with Object Read & Write on the bucket, in the same account as the endpoint Account ID. Paste into R2_ACCESS_KEY_ID and R2_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY.
alerts.uploadR2AccessDenied: The R2 S3 token has no permission on this bucket (or the endpoint Account ID belongs to another account). Create a new token in R2 → Manage R2 API Tokens with Object Read & Write on that bucket.
alerts.profileSoon: Name and email come from your account. Changes land in a later release.

password.too_short: Password must be at least 8 characters.
